notes: Bag types now come only from Master → Item List → Bag type. Each bag type there has ⚙ Stock settings (kind: bag / 5 kg inner / combo / liner, empty weight, minimum stock, buyer's own bags, liner) and the list shows them. Below the list, 'Other bag names used' on buyers' items or invoices can be joined to a bag type (Same as) or added to the list. Factory → Bags has no Bag types tab any more; bag entries only take bag types of the Item List; names not in the list are marked in the stock.
